meta.title: Example: a clinic's own booking system
meta.description: Try a clinic booking system the way a patient sees it on their phone, and see what reaches the clinic dashboard: mada payments, WhatsApp reminders and ZATCA-ready invoices.

header.lead: Book an appointment the way a patient does on their phone, and watch it reach the clinic dashboard at the same moment.
header.notice: A fictional clinic with fictional data. No message is sent and no money is charged.

booking.name: Name
booking.phoneError: Enter a Saudi mobile number: 10 digits starting with 05
booking.depositNote: The deposit comes off the treatment price and is refunded if you cancel 24 hours ahead.
booking.doneLead: A confirmation reached you on WhatsApp:
booking.waConfirm: Hi {name}, your appointment at {clinic}, {branch}, is confirmed for {day} at {time} with {doctor}. Deposit paid: {amount}. Reply to this message to change or cancel.
booking.waReminder: Reminder: your appointment at {clinic} is at {time}. See you soon.
booking.waReminderNote: Sent automatically 24 hours before the appointment

dashboard.empty: No appointments at this branch today.
dashboard.activityEmpty: Book an appointment on the phone and activity shows up here.

invoice.title: Simplified tax invoice
invoice.qr: QR code in the format ZATCA requires

booking.title: Online booking under your name
booking.text: A booking page on your domain, with your real branches, services, doctors and opening hours.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp confirmations and reminders
whatsapp.text: A confirmation the moment someone books, an automatic reminder before the visit, and a link to change or cancel.

payments.title: Deposits with mada and Apple Pay
payments.text: Patients pay a deposit when they book, so fewer booked slots go unused.

zatca.title: ZATCA-ready invoices
zatca.text: A simplified tax invoice with a QR code for every payment.

branches.title: One dashboard for every branch
branches.text: Today's schedule, deposits and reminders per branch or all together.

owned.title: Your system, your data
owned.text: No commission per booking, and patient data stays with you, not with a middleman platform.

features.note: This example shows the idea. Your system is built around your clinic and goes live within 30 working days at a fixed price.
